project.description: New two-story coach house with one dwelling unit over a garage, behind an existing building. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: Show on the site plan that the coach house does not remove required off-street parking.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: Glazed and openable areas for the second floor bedroom are not shown, so natural light and ventilation can't be verified. Add them to the window schedule.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Per former 13-64, smoke alarm locations are not shown. Show them on the electrical plan.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: The rear exterior wall is close to the lot line. Its fire-resistance rating is not indicated on the elevation.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: A notarized letter from the owner authorizing the expediter is missing from the application.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: For your information, an inspector will be assigned when the permit is issued. No response is needed.

expected.why: Parking layout is a design matter shown on the site plan, under the parking chapter of the zoning ordinance.
Window areas are design data for the architect. Don't invent areas.
Title 13 was replaced. Detection layout is a life-safety design decision, despite the General heading.
Exterior wall rating is fire-resistance design, not an elevation drafting note.
Only the owner can sign this letter.
Informational; the letter says no response is needed.
